label: CONNECTION

points.heading: Say good morning properly
points.body: Eye contact and a smile, before the phone.

points.heading: Share one plan for the day
points.body: Knowing what each other’s day looks like helps you feel like a team.
points.panel: “What’s the hardest part of your day today?”

points.heading: A six-second hug
points.body: Long enough to feel it, short enough for a busy morning.
points.panel: Hug before either of you leaves, and don’t rush it.

points.heading: Make one small kindness
points.body: Coffee made, a lunch packed, a coat warmed.
points.panel: Do one small thing for him tomorrow morning.

points.heading: Send one mid-morning text
points.body: A little link between your two busy worlds.
points.panel: “Hope the meeting goes well. Proud of you.”

close.save: Save this and try it tomorrow.

caption:
How a couple starts the day often shapes how they treat each other for the rest of it.

These five small habits take only a few minutes, but they help mornings feel less like a race and more like a team leaving the house together. Pick one to try first.

Save this and try it tomorrow, and follow @spotseason for more small steps.
